title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - ExampleAI
text: ExampleAI is hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer in Berlin, Germany. You will build retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, fine-tune open-source LLMs, and ship production NLP services on FastAPI and Kubernetes. Requirements: 5+ years of Python, experience with PyTorch, and fluency in English. Hybrid work from our Berlin office, three days a week. Apply with your CV and a short motivation letter describing why you want to join our team.

title: Machine Learning Engineer, NLP - DataForge
text: DataForge is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our NLP team in Berlin. We offer relocation support for candidates moving to Berlin and a hybrid schedule. Strong PyTorch and TensorFlow skills required, plus working German is a plus for this role.

title: About ExampleAI
text: ExampleAI builds retrieval-augmented generation tools that help enterprises search and reason over their internal documents. Founded in 2019, the company has raised two funding rounds and serves customers across finance, insurance and logistics. Our mission is to make organizational knowledge instantly accessible through natural language. Read more on our engineering blog.
